column2: cat(glue::glue(r"---(**Model fit.** Adjusted R² goes from <<round(summary(m_log_b)$adj.r.squared, 3)>> to <<round(summary(m_log2)$adj.r.squared, 3)>>. The F-test comparing the nested models gives p <<ifelse(pF < 0.001, "< 0.001", paste0("= ", signif(pF, 2)))>> and AIC changes by <<round(-dAIC, 2)>> (lower is better). Overall, adding the park-and-ride indicator <<ifelse(pF < 0.05 & dAIC > 2, "significantly improves model fit.", "does not meaningfully improve model fit.")>>)---", .open = "<<", .close = ">>"), "\n\n")

**Model fit.** Adjusted R² goes from 0.312 to 0.312. The F-test comparing the nested models gives p = 0.95 and AIC changes by 2 (lower is better). Overall, adding the park-and-ride indicator does not meaningfully improve model fit.
